messages:
Maya (oncall): incident-bot just posted a page for high notify-latency but I don't see it in PagerDuty. Anyone else missing the incidents there?
Sam R (eng-sre): I can confirm PD didn't create an incident for that event id: evt_7a9c. We got the webhook from incident-bot but PD returned 409 duplicate on our side? weird.
InfraBot: POST /integrations/pagerduty/events -> 200 accepted (incident-bot)
Pagerflow Bot: outbound webhook to PagerDuty gateway responded 202, PD returned request-id 0x1a2b (gateway).
Eve (support): customers pinging support: "we didn't get any paging alerts, but UI shows degraded state" — looks like on-call didn't get pages.
Sam R (eng-sre): digging logs now. Early sign: our outbound proxy is rewriting Idempotency-Key header for retries. PagerDuty dedup is based on dedup_key + idempotency header and we might be getting mismatched keys so PD rejects as duplicate when earlier request succeeded but didn't produce an incident.
Frank (eng-infra): adding logs:```
2026-03-15T18:12:45Z outbound-gw request_id=abc123 idempotency=evt_7a9c-retry status=202
2026-03-15T18:12:45Z pd-gw response=409 body={"error":"Duplicate event"} request_id=abc123
```
Maya (oncall): wait, so some requests succeeded and others got 409 -> could explain PD not creating? If first call failed but our gateway marked success, that explains the mismatch.
Sam R (eng-sre): yep. It looks like an async ack path in the gateway updated our local state before PD actually created the incident. The gateway returned 202 upstream but downstream response loop returned 409 and wasn't propagated. There's a race: our incident-bot assumes success as soon as gateway ACKs, but gateway accepts and enqueues, then downstream dedup returns 409 on processing.
Grace (sre-manager): what's the immediate mitigation? Can we re-send pages manually to PD?
Maya (oncall): I'll flip to manual paging for the next 30m and ping SRE to do manual PD incidents for active customer pages. @Sam R can you add a temporary mitigation in the console?
Sam R (eng-sre): doing manual PD create for the three impacted alert groups: notify-latency-high (x3 customers). Also toggling the incident-bot route to bypass outbound-gateway.
InfraBot: changed routing: incident-bot -> direct-pagerflow (bypass outbound-gw) by sam-r
Maya (oncall): Confirmed PD incidents created for the active alerts. Customers are being paged now.
Frank (eng-infra): root cause hypothesis: a recent proxy optimization introduced a parallel path that ACKs on enqueue and returns 202 to callers before downstream dedup logic runs. That means our dedup state can become inconsistent.
Sam R (eng-sre): immediate patch: ensure outbound-gateway waits for final downstream code before returning 2xx, and preserve original Idempotency-Key header rather than rewriting on retry. I'll open PR and patch.
Sam R (eng-sre): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/outbound-gw/pulls/452 - adds sync ack and keeps idemp-key.
Eve (support): I've emailed affected customers with status and manual escalation info. No customer functional data loss, only missed paging.
Grace (sre-manager): Good. Next actions?
Maya (oncall): 1) Sam to deploy hotfix to outbound-gw (blocking reverts) 2) Frank to run soak in staging for idempotency behavior 3) Incident retro tomorrow to review routing tests.
Sam R (eng-sre): Hotfix deployed to prod-canary at 18:28Z. Canary looks green. Rolling to prod now.
InfraBot: deploy status: prod-canary -> success, prod -> rolling (3/6 nodes)
Maya (oncall): prod rollout complete. Observability shows successful PD create rate back to normal.
Sam R (eng-sre): added temporary regression test to e2e: assert PD incident created <= 5s of outbound call and idempotency header preserved.
Frank (eng-infra): will run postmortem on the proxy change and revert if tests fail.
Grace (sre-manager): schedule 1hr post-incident review at 09:00PT tomorrow. Include PM and infra owner.
Maya (oncall): thanks all. Logging this thread for the retro. tagging @Pagerflow Bot for visibility. :white_check_mark:
Pagerflow Bot: acknowledged. Telemetry: 3 alerts manual-created, 0 ongoing suppressed alerts.
Maya (oncall): closing the immediate on-call loop — if anything new pops up re-open this thread or escalate to #pager-emergency.
